# Fenix Nordic Solutions

> Open source systems for Danish municipalities and Nordic teams: hosted in Europe, owned outright, priced for the work rather than the licence. Based in Skanderborg, Denmark, delivering anywhere.

## What we do

- IT cost and licence audit: what to cut, replace or right-size, with the savings attached
- Off-cloud migration to your own servers or a European VPS, under EU jurisdiction
- Custom open source solutions when an expensive tool only solves part of the problem
- Websites, platforms and integration: headless CMS, Nuxt and Vue, API integration
- Drupal migration, upgrades and support: sixteen years, from single sites to large archives
- Continuous maintenance: dependencies, security releases and platform updates as routine

## Products

- AabenForms (https://aabenforms.dk, case study at https://fenixnordic.solutions/aabenforms): open source platform for municipal self-service and case workflows. MitID and NemLog-in, Digital Post (SF1601), CPR and CVR lookups (SF1520, SF1530, SF6006), journalising (SF1470), distribution (SF2900), ESDH connectors for GetOrganized, SBSYS, WorkZone and Acadre. Drupal 11 and Nuxt. GPL. Pre-pilot proof of concept: the engine is real, certificates and a pilot municipality are missing.
- AabenIntra (https://aabenintra.fenixnordic.solutions, case study at https://fenixnordic.solutions/aabenintra): open source intranet on Drupal 11 for municipalities and organisations. Personal dashboard, targeted news, directory with organisational structure, recognition wall, mandatory reading with receipts. Danish and English. From 7,500 DKK a month including hosting and maintenance. Proof of concept with a public demo.

## Cases

- South African History Online (https://www.sahistory.org.za): one of the largest free history archives on the continent. Technical lead since 2010, digital transformation ongoing. Drupal, self-hosted, no paygate.
